title: Real Numbers and Decimal Expansions
description: Understanding rational and irrational numbers, decimal expansions
learningObjectives: Differentiate between rational and irrational numbers
Represent real numbers on the number line
Understand decimal expansions (terminating and non-terminating)
Perform operations on real numbers including laws of exponents

title: Laws of Exponents
description: Operations on real numbers with exponents
learningObjectives: Apply laws of exponents for real numbers
Express numbers in standard form using exponents
Solve problems involving exponents and powers
Understand negative and zero exponents

title: Polynomials - Definition and Types
description: Definition of polynomials, types based on degree and number of terms
learningObjectives: Define polynomial and identify polynomial expressions
Classify polynomials by degree (linear, quadratic, cubic) and number of terms
Understand the concept of zero of a polynomial
Distinguish between polynomial and non-polynomial expressions

title: Zeros of Polynomials
learningObjectives: Find the zeros of a polynomial
Understand the relationship between zeros and coefficients
Apply the Remainder Theorem
Apply the Factor Theorem for factorisation

title: Cartesian Plane and Plotting Points
description: Understanding the Cartesian plane and plotting points
learningObjectives: Understand the Cartesian coordinate system (x-y plane)
Plot points given ordered pairs (x, y)
Identify the four quadrants and their characteristics
Locate points on the coordinate plane

title: Distance Formula and Section Formula
description: Calculating distances and dividing line segments
learningObjectives: Calculate distance between two points using the distance formula
Apply the section formula to find points dividing a segment
Solve problems involving coordinates and distances
Use coordinate geometry in real-world contexts

title: Solving Linear Equations in Two Variables
description: Finding solutions and graphing linear equations in two variables
learningObjectives: Find solutions (x, y) for linear equations in two variables
Plot the graph of a linear equation in two variables
Understand that a linear equation in two variables has infinitely many solutions
Apply to real-world problems involving two variables

title: Graphs of Linear Equations
description: Understanding the graphical representation of linear equations
learningObjectives: Plot the graph of linear equations of the form y = mx + c
Identify slope (m) and y-intercept (c) from the equation
Understand the relationship between algebraic and graphical forms
Apply graphing to solve real-world problems

title: Euclid's Axioms and Postulates
description: Understanding the axiomatic approach to geometry
learningObjectives: Understand Euclid's definitions, axioms, and postulates
differentiate between axioms and postulates
Apply Euclid's axioms to geometric reasoning
Understand how mathematical proofs are constructed

title: Properties of Lines and Angles
description: Exploring properties of intersecting and parallel lines
learningObjectives: Understand properties of angles formed by intersecting lines
Apply properties of parallel lines cut by a transversal
Use the angle sum property of triangles
Solve problems involving unknown angles

title: Triangle Congruence Criteria
description: SAS, ASA, AAS, SSS, RHS congruence criteria
learningObjectives: Apply SSS congruence criterion
Apply SAS congruence criterion
Apply ASA congruence criterion
Apply AAS congruence criterion
Apply RHS congruence criterion for right triangles

title: Triangle Properties and Inequalities
description: Properties of triangles and important inequality theorems
learningObjectives: Apply the angle sum property (180°)
Apply the exterior angle property
Apply the triangle inequality theorem
Understand properties of isosceles and equilateral triangles

title: Quadrilateral Properties and Mid-point Theorem
description: Properties of quadrilaterals and the mid-point theorem
learningObjectives: Apply properties of parallelograms, rectangles, rhombuses, squares
Understand and use the mid-point theorem
Solve problems involving quadrilateral angles and sides
Relate quadrilateral properties to real-world shapes

title: Circle Geometry - Chords and Properties
description: Properties of chords, arcs, and angles in circles
learningObjectives: Understand properties of chords of a circle
Apply theorems related to angles subtended by chords
Solve problems involving cyclic quadrilaterals
Use circle properties in geometric proofs

title: Heron's Formula for Triangle Area
description: Calculating area of a triangle given three sides
learningObjectives: Apply Heron's formula to find triangle area
Calculate semi-perimeter of a triangle
Apply Heron's formula to find area of quadrilaterals
Solve real-world problems involving triangle area

title: Surface Areas and Volumes of 3D Shapes
description: Calculating surface areas and volumes of common 3D shapes
learningObjectives: Calculate surface area of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres
Calculate volume of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres
Apply concepts to real-world problems (containers, tanks, etc.)
Differentiate between surface area and volume

title: Measures of Central Tendency
description: Mean, median, and mode of data sets
learningObjectives: Calculate mean, median, and mode for ungrouped data
Organise data into frequency distributions
Construct bar graphs and histograms
Compare different measures of central tendency

title: Basic Probability Concepts
learningObjectives: Understand the basic concept of probability
Calculate probability of simple events
Understand equally likely outcomes
Solve simple probability problems

title: Advanced Geometric Constructions
description: Detailed constructions using compass and ruler
learningObjectives: Construct triangles given various conditions
Bisect angles and line segments accurately
Construct perpendicular bisectors
Apply construction skills to solve geometric problems
